label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode.
releaseNotes:
* Software Threat Mode for radar-triggered warning lights
* Interactive Radar Simulator for indoor desk testing
* Physical light mode confirmation (Turquoise status icon)
* Universal BLE auto-discovery and reconnection during rides
* Sequential Command Queue and 150ms Debounce Guard
